name: wpu
description: Build, fix and optimise WordPress/Elementor sites through the WPU Bridge: design-to-Elementor builds (Claude Design or reference sites), custom plugins with a security gate, Rank Math/Yoast SEO from DataForSEO data, blog posts, speed and security, plus typed bridge tools for Gutenberg and page builders (Divi, Bricks, Beaver Builder, Breakdance, SeedProd), draft themes, WooCommerce, ACF and checked plugin updates, and WPU Desk (a local browser dashboard). Merges Elementor Ready To Use Templates (Forge), WP Site Build and WP Site Doctor.
